report: I downloaded what I thought was a PDF of our course material from a Telegram group. After opening it, my computer became very slow. I see a program called "svchost_helper.exe" running in task manager that was not there before. My antivirus (Windows Defender) flagged it as Trojan:Win32/Wacatac.B!ml but said it could not remove it. IP address in the connection list: 45.33.32.156.
